statements.label: B
statements.sql: SELECT a.club_id, ROUND(a.balance, 2) AS account_balance, a.updated_at, (SELECT e.id FROM ledger_entries e WHERE e.club_id = a.club_id ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS tail_id, (SELECT ROUND(e.balance_after, 2) FROM ledger_entries e WHERE e.club_id = a.club_id ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS tail_balance, CASE WHEN ROUND(a.balance, 2) = ROUND((SELECT e.balance_after FROM ledger_entries e WHERE e.club_id = a.club_id ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1), 2) THEN 'consistent' ELSE 'DRIFT' END AS invariant FROM ledger_accounts a WHERE a.club_id IN (5, 280, 449) ORDER BY a.club_id

statements.label: C
statements.sql: SELECT e.club_id, e.id, e.kind, ROUND(e.amount, 2) AS amount, e.balance_after, e.created_at FROM ledger_entries e WHERE e.club_id IN (5, 280, 449) AND e.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = e.club_id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647 ORDER BY e.club_id, e.id

statements.label: D
statements.sql: SELECT ct.club_id, c.name, ROUND(SUM(ct.wage), 2) AS wage_sum, COUNT(*) AS n FROM contracts ct JOIN clubs c ON c.id = ct.club_id WHERE ct.is_active = 1 AND ct.club_id IS NOT NULL AND ct.wage IS NOT NULL AND ct.club_id IN (5, 280, 449) GROUP BY ct.club_id, c.name ORDER BY ct.club_id

statements.label: I
statements.sql: SELECT c.id AS club_id, c.name, (SELECT w.id FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AS wage_id, (SELECT MIN(m.id) FROM ledger_entries m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647) AS next_id, (SELECT x.balance_after FROM ledger_entries x WHERE x.club_id = c.id AND x.kind = 'wage' AND x.ref_type = 'window' AND x.ref_id = 901) AS wage_bal, (SELECT n.balance_after FROM ledger_entries n WHERE n.club_id = c.id AND n.id = (SELECT MIN(m.id) FROM ledger_entries m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647)) AS next_bal, CASE WHEN (SELECT MIN(m.id) FROM ledger_entries m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647) IS NULL THEN 'no-downstream' WHEN ROUND((SELECT n.balance_after FROM ledger_entries n WHERE n.club_id = c.id AND n.id = (SELECT MIN(m.id) FROM ledger_entries m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647)), 2) = ROUND((SELECT x.balance_after FROM ledger_entries x WHERE x.club_id = c.id AND x.kind = 'wage' AND x.ref_type = 'window' AND x.ref_id = 901) + (SELECT n.amount FROM ledger_entries n WHERE n.club_id = c.id AND n.id = (SELECT MIN(m.id) FROM ledger_entries m WHERE m.club_id = c.id AND m.id BETWEEN (SELECT w.id + 1 FROM ledger_entries w WHERE w.club_id = c.id AND w.kind = 'wage' AND w.ref_type = 'window' AND w.ref_id = 901) AND 2147483647)), 2) THEN 'linked' ELSE 'broken' END AS chain FROM clubs c WHERE c.id IN (5, 280, 449, 241, 112172) ORDER BY c.id
